display.purpose: Page H1 stencils only. Archivo Black, uppercase, line-height 0.9.

title.purpose: Card titles, nav, section labels. Mono uppercase wide tracking.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, findings, form help. IBM Plex Mono 14px.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Default edge. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: hairline-hover
shadows.purpose: Selected/hover edge on tiles. Reticle, not glow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Steel fill, square, uppercase. Default action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #eaeaea; color: #0a0a0a; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(234 234 234 / 90%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eaeaea; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent square with hairline. Secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #eaeaea; border: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #171717; border-color: rgb(234 234 234 / 40%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eaeaea; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #e61919; color: #fafafa; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgb(230 25 25 / 90%); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eaeaea; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: #171717; color: #eaeaea; border: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(234 234 234 / 50%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Square deck panel. Stamp title, 20px padding.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #111111; color: #eaeaea; border: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #a3a3a3; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(10 10 10 / 90%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-brand { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #eaeaea; } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3a3a3; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { color: #eaeaea; } .ds-link-active { color: #e61919; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eaeaea; }

components.name: Hit Badge
components.description: Square stamp. Hit is the only filled hazard chip.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-hit { background: #e61919; border-color: #e61919; color: #fafafa; }

components.name: Reticle Frame
components.description: Signature: four hazard corner ticks on a live/status panel.

components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; background: #111111; border: 1px solid rgb(234 234 234 / 14%); border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; min-height: 88px; } .ds-tick { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-tick-tl { top: 0; left: 0; border-top: 2px solid #e61919; border-left: 2px solid #e61919; } .ds-tick-tr { top: 0; right: 0; border-top: 2px solid #e61919; border-right: 2px solid #e61919; } .ds-tick-bl { bottom: 0; left: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #e61919; border-left: 2px solid #e61919; } .ds-tick-br { bottom: 0; right: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #e61919; border-right: 2px solid #e61919; } .ds-stamp { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #737373; }

narrative.overview:
RedTeamForge looks like a weapons-lab terminal, not a SaaS dashboard. The screen is a dark steel deck. Type is mono except when a page title hits like a stencil. Corners are square. The only color that shouts is hazard red — and it shouts rarely, like a reticle, not a brand wash.

Personality is tactical, dense, and dry. Density is cockpit-level without becoming noise: hairline borders, uppercase stamps, tabular numbers. Atmosphere comes from a faint scanline and film grain over the whole viewport, not from glow, glass, or illustration.

This is a committed dark product. There is no light theme. There is no second accent. There is no rounded corner.
keyCharacteristics: Zero radius on every control, card, badge, and sheet
One accent (#e61919) used as a targeting mark, never as a fill for large regions
Archivo Black for page titles only; IBM Plex Mono for everything else
Depth by fill step (bg → surface → elevated), never by drop shadow
Scanline + grain overlay, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The One Hazard Rule
rules.body: Hazard red is a reticle, not a theme. No red page backgrounds, no red hero washes, no red-to-orange gradients. If a screen needs color besides steel and red, it is a verdict badge.

rules.name: The Dark Deck Rule
rules.body: The product is dark-only. Do not add a light theme, cream paper, or inverted marketing sections inside the app.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black is for H1/H2 stencils. Everything else is IBM Plex Mono. Do not introduce a third family.

rules.name: The Stamp Case Rule
rules.body: Nav, card titles, badges, and labels are uppercase with wide tracking. Sentence case is for body copy and findings only.

rules.name: The 44px Floor
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, nav items, and icon buttons are at least 44×44. Do not ship 32px or 36px controls.

rules.name: The Flat Deck Rule
rules.body: If you need hierarchy, step the fill (bg / surface / elevated) or the border. Do not add box-shadow blurs, glass, or gradient meshes.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: rounded-none is not a preference. Adding rounded-md or pills breaks the system. Exception: none.

dos: Do follow this file for every new page, redesign, and tweak. DESIGN.md is the visual authority.
Do keep radius at 0 and the control floor at 44px.
Do use hazard red as a sparse signal (nav active, hit, destructive, reticle).
Do set page titles in Archivo Black uppercase and body in IBM Plex Mono.
Do reuse Button, Card, Input, Frame, Stamp, Badge before inventing new chrome.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (kill scanline, grain, and rise).
donts: Don't add a second accent, a light theme, or a purple/blue AI glow.
Don't introduce Inter, Geist, a serif, or a rounded geometric sans.
Don't use drop shadows, glassmorphism, gradient text, or pill buttons.
Don't fill large regions with hazard red.
Don't put reticle ticks on every container — only on live/status frames.
Don't ship controls shorter than 44px or type smaller than 12px for labels.
Don't invent a new visual language because a feature is new. Extend this one.
